notes.text: Player assignments as NPCs should NEVER persist between scenes. If a scene is returned to and that character was playing themselves, or was playing a different NPC, the assignment they had at the scene they are returning to must be restored.
Advancement from INTERMISSION to PLAY should not be permitted before the onboarding sequence has been run (i.e. the asset bundle load, the XML refresh, and the seating triggers)

Upon switching the music via the dropdown in the scene preview panel, the selected option did not change and remained showing the default scene audio. Volume for both the music and the ambient audio both display zero, instead of the actual volume of the tracks for the scene.
